title: MRC Partners violation appeal nearing final continuance
summary: On September 24, the appeal by MRC Partners LLC, which challenges a notice of violation, stayed unresolved, with the appellant's representative saying talks with the county are ongoing and another meeting may follow the last proposal. The chair recalled having called the last hearing's continuance the last one, and asked whether the parties are close. The chair set November 27th as the deadline for any added documents.
